entry.title: MINK 1.0.5
entry.summary: A setup window and portable zip, Windows file association with icon and right-click Run, Check and Build, mink fmt, mink lsp and a VS Code extension, icons and version information in built programs, mink upgrade and side-by-side versions. The files are unsigned for now.
